entities.summary: Wilhelm von Kaulbach was a German painter, noted mainly as a muralist, but also as a book illustrator. His murals decorate buildings in Munich. He is associated with the Düsseldorf school of painting. Wilhelm von Kaulbach was a writers & intellectuals from Bad Arolsen (1805-10-15, Bad Arolsen–1874-04-07). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
